overreach: Eye diagram is part of the high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow, alongside IL, Xtalk and TDR impedance.[28]
The R&S signal-integrity flow identifies measurable items including IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram and TDR impedance.[28]
Oscilloscope capability should support resolving PCIe Gen5 post-EQ eye height in the ~15 mV range and eye width around 9.375 ps
An oscilloscope used to observe PCIe Gen5 12 ps rise/fall behavior would need bandwidth on the order of 29 GHz
review.reason: The answer’s main chain—high-speed SerDes/PCIe context, PCIe eye-opening and rise/fall measurable parameters, scopes being among validation instruments, and lack of AI-server oscilloscope mapping—is broadly grounded in the cited passages and is appropriately caveated. Some oscilloscope-specific capability statements are inferred rather than directly stated, and the cited [28] excerpt does not show the claimed SI flow items IL/Xtalk/Eye/TDR.
